row:
Algonquin Chiropractic Center is a chiropractic clinic that specializes in treating sciatica, spinal stenosis, herniated discs and peripheral neuropathy. Our mission is to provide an alternative to drugs and surgery for health and wellness.

We employ many chiropractic techniques to help people overcome all types of musculoskeletal pain. These include the Cox Technic, physical therapy, sports medicine, orthotics and more.

Our founder, Dr. Anthony Galante, has practiced as a chiropractor for over 28 years. He is a licensed chiropractic physician and a certified chiropractic sports physician.

We want to help you overcome your pain! Call us today at 847-854-2000 to set up an appointment at our office in Algonquin, IL.
